derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1830 (ἐξερευνάω);
def: not searched out, i.e. (by implication) inscrutable

occurrences.text: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
